## Notes

Created by Steve Grand at Millennium Interactive; haploid genetics with no dominance and no recombination between loci; simulated biochemistry and organs; neural-network brain with one sight neuron group per object type; drive-reduction learning; word teaching and typed instructions; lifespan about 40 hours; Grendels carry disease; online Norn-swapping community.
